name: OSW Old-School Championship
epitaph: OSW Online's top championship, vacant through the fed's first seven months: Def Bellows won it in the final of an eight-man tournament at the Field Trip of 3 September 2002 and still held it at the end of the year.

name: OSW Television Championship
epitaph: OSW Online's first title, won by Chris Colton over Dark Soul in the final of a four-man tournament on 2 April 2002; he held it through the rest of 2002.

name: OSW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Claimed for months by self-declared champions, the title was made official at the Field Trip of 3 September 2002, when Sexual Energy won it; they still held it at the end of the year.
